_meta.note: GRID VERIFIED 2026-08-06 (grid drawn over the PNG at 9x — lines land exactly on tile edges; 160x240 / 16 = 10x15 = 150 frames, no remainder). Desert auto-tile terrain for a desert floor variant; the arid counterpart to forest/snow autotiles. LABELED: 10 complete terrains — sand-dirt, sand-grass, sand-darkdirt, sand-water and sand-palebrick/sand-redbrick, with -overlay (transparent-background) twins of dirt/grass/darkdirt/water. Every block is a 3x3 outer set with its 2x2 inner-corner set 3 columns to the right. Frames 23/24/28/29 are plain sand fill variants; the remaining 16 frames are empty.
